# zstd / dictionary_loader

zstd's own fuzz target `dictionary_loader` ([source](source/dictionary_loader.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zstd (facebook/zstd at 82d322c4).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: The input is both the dictionary (random load method, content type auto/raw/full, loadDictionary vs refPrefix) and the data: if ZSTD_compress2 succeeds, decompression with the same dictionary must succeed, regenerate the input size and match byte for byte.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zstd at commit 82d322c4.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- The input is both the dictionary (random load method, content type auto/raw/full, loadDictionary vs refPrefix) and the data: if ZSTD_compress2 succeeds, decompression with the same dictionary must succeed, regenerate the input size and match byte for byte ([lines 88-98](source/dictionary_loader.c#L88-L98)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- With ZSTD_dct_rawContent, compression must never fail ("Raw must always succeed!") ([lines 90-93](source/dictionary_loader.c#L90-L93)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies them on every input it covers.

Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zstd` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
